binding_note: Every path listed in sha256 is verified by validate_freeze() before any dispatch. This freeze.json is deliberately NOT in the map: a self-hash would make the file's own digest unstable. The freeze digest is instead bound by authorization_request.json.
conditions_not_equivalent: The two models receive byte-identical message text but are not run under identical sampling: MiMo thinking forces temperature=1.0 and top_p=0.95, while DeepSeek thinking ignores temperature=0 and uses provider-native sampling defaults.
The same numeric completion ceiling covers reasoning plus visible output, but tokenizers and the reasoning/answer allocation differ between providers.
Model aliases do not pin immutable weights; the MiMo immutable version is UNKNOWN.
Costs derived from usage are estimates, not settled invoices; cache accounting may be missing.
A 300 s socket timeout is not a strict generation wall deadline.
Six public static diagnostic tasks with no tools and no agent loop cannot establish formal rankings, significance, or stable capability differences.
The DeepSeek Flash price basis is UNKNOWN, so its cost cannot be asserted at present; the base freeze's Pro rates must not be reused.

changed_relative_to_base: deepseek execution path: DS-Harness controlled Provider
deepseek cost basis: Pro peak rates are NOT Flash rates and are not reused
derived_from.derivation_reason: The base pilot froze deepseek-v4-pro with a deepseek-pro price basis. This derived freeze re-binds the same six tasks, prompts and evaluator to DeepSeek's flash model under the DS-Harness controlled Provider path. A run under the base freeze must NOT be recorded as this configuration, and vice versa.

dsh_execution_environment.controller_budget_policy: The controller model is a separate paid model (deepseek-official/deepseek-flash, reasoningEffort max) whose spend is NOT part of the 12 measured calls. It must be capped explicitly by the human in the authorization; the runner does not meter it and no default cap is assumed.
dsh_execution_environment.dsh_version_note: The documented checkout path D:\DSH-desktop\resources\app.asar\dsh does not exist on this machine and the profile has no node_modules, so an exact DSH package version could not be read. app.asar byte size is recorded instead.
dsh_execution_environment.transport: Python standard library urllib only. The vendor SDK is NOT used, so no SDK-level retry exists. No DSH retry plugin participates in the outbound call.

offline_capture.retry_probe_result: In every mode exactly 12 transport calls were issued, at most 1 per (model, task) pair. No automatic retry exists in the frozen path.

deepseek.model_id_note: deepseek-flash is the official model name and maps to DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash; legacy names deepseek-v4-flash and deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp are still accepted and billed at Flash price. Confirmed from the official pricing page, no probe call made. Service identity is still checked in the real response.
deepseek.prices_cny_per_million_note: Peak rates, official CNY page 2026-10-09. Off-peak is half: input_miss 1, input_hit 0.02, output 4.
deepseek.worst_cost_basis: Rounded UP from the computed peak worst case 0.224768 CNY (16384 input cache-miss @ 2 CNY/M + 24000 output @ 8 CNY/M). Off-peak worst case is 0.112384 CNY.

xiaomi.worst_cost_basis: Rounded UP from the computed worst case 0.193152 CNY (16384 input cache-miss @ 3 CNY/M + 24000 output @ 6 CNY/M).

source_independence_caveat: Six distinct frozen source_incident_id clusters. Contract fixtures and synthetic controls are not six independently sampled real incidents. Same-author truth/evaluator construction is retained; evidence independence is not claimed.
stop_rules: No key access or requests before explicit human batch authorization plus key-rotation confirmation bound to this freeze SHA and the entry SHA.
Reserve the full request/token/cost ceiling in the append-only trace before each single dispatch; never refund a reservation.

Stop the batch on: authentication failure, HTTP 429, model identity mismatch or missing model metadata, suspected credential leakage in output, per-call token budget breach, measured timeout overrun, missing or invalid usage, or exhausted budget.
No retry, no run restart, no higher-token rerun, no third measured model, no automatic full comparison.
A failed or uncertain-status request still consumes its request allowance.
Answer, format and reason errors retain the frozen score; evaluator review never modifies the evaluator during execution.
An interrupted reservation is an unresolved attempted request; do not restart or replay it over the network.
timeout_semantics: socket I/O timeout; no guaranteed total wall deadline; stop the next dispatch on measured overrun.
usage_missing_policy: Keep the full cost/token reservation, estimated actual cost UNKNOWN, stop further dispatch; never infer zero usage.
